oe_romp_consecrate_pantheon_seat = {
	type = religious
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			religion = religion:hellenism_religion
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_romp_human_only_action_tt
				is_ai = no
			}
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_romp_consecrate_pantheon_seat
		years = 3
	}

	price = price:oe_romp_consecrate_pantheon_seat_price

	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = religion
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_religion"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp_ritual.10
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_romp_consecrate_pantheon_seat_effect_tt
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -100
	}
}

oe_romp_declare_secular_games = {
	type = religious
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			religion = religion:hellenism_religion
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_romp_mod_secular_games }
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_romp_declare_secular_games
		years = 25
	}

	price = price:oe_romp_declare_secular_games_price

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 18
	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 6
	player_automated_category = religiousdoctrines

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = religion
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_religion"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_romp_mod_secular_games
				years = 10
				mode = replace
			}
			add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:oe_romp_ludi_saeculares_aspect
				}
				add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
				add_religious_influence = religious_influence_mild_bonus
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = capital }
				capital = {
					change_prosperity = prosperity_mild_bonus
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_dlc = "d008_fate_of_the_phoenix" }
					capital = {
						spawn_movement = {
							movement_definition = movement_definition:hellenism_religion_movement
							supporters = {
								value = population
								multiply = 0.08
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 18
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:oe_romp_ludi_saeculares_aspect }
			}
			add = 10
		}
	}
}

oe_romp_consecrate_triumphal_temple = {
	type = religious
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			religion = religion:hellenism_religion
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			exists = capital
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_romp_triumphal_temple_allow_tt
				OR = {
					has_variable = recently_won_a_war
					army_tradition >= 40
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_romp_consecrate_triumphal_temple
		years = 15
	}

	price = price:oe_romp_consecrate_triumphal_temple_price

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 6
	player_automated_category = religiousdoctrines

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = religion
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_religion"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		source = actor
		target_flag = target_location
		name = "choose_location"
		none_available_msg_key = "no_locations_available"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = control }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			OR = {
				is_capital = yes
				location_rank = location_rank:city
				location_rank = location_rank:town
			}
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_romp_loc_triumphal_vow }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target_location }
			scope:target_location = {
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_romp_loc_triumphal_vow
					years = 20
					mode = replace
				}
				create_art = {
					quality = 75
					type = work_of_art_type:monument
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = capital }
					capital = {
						add_location_modifier = {
							modifier = oe_romp_loc_triumphal_vow
							years = 20
							mode = replace
						}
						create_art = {
							quality = 75
							type = work_of_art_type:monument
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:actor = {
			add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:oe_romp_triumphal_vow_mars_aspect
				}
				add_army_tradition = army_tradition_mild_bonus
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 14
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:oe_romp_triumphal_vow_mars_aspect }
			}
			add = 8
		}
	}
}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_romp_sanctify_vestal_flame

	}

	price = price:oe_romp_sanctify_vestal_flame_price

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 6
	player_automated_category = religiousdoctrines

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = religion
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_religion"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_romp_mod_vestal_flame
				years = 10
				mode = replace
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:oe_romp_vestal_flame_aspect
				}
				add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = capital }
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = oe_romp_vestal_flame_satisfaction_tt
					capital.province = {
						hidden_effect = {
							every_location_in_province = {
								limit = {
									has_owner = yes
									owner = scope:actor
								}
								ordered_pop = {
									limit = {
										owner = scope:actor
									}
									order_by = pop_size
									max = 4
									check_range_bounds = no
									add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_mild_bonus
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 15
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:oe_romp_vestal_flame_aspect }
			}
			add = 10
		}
	}
}
